title: Style a Personal Intro Card
description: Create an external stylesheet to style a simple HTML card with colors, fonts, and backgrounds.
problemStatement:
You are given the following HTML for a profile card: ```html

John Doe

Web Developer

Passionate about creating accessible and beautiful web experiences.

Contact Me
``` Create an **external CSS file** named `card.css`. Style the card to look modern and appealing: - The `.card` should have: - Background colour: `#ffffff` - A light shadow (use `box-shadow`) - Rounded corners (`border-radius`) - Padding of 30px - Maximum width of 400px - The `h2` inside should: - Have colour `#2c3e50` - Font family: `'Georgia', serif` - No margin on top - The `.title` should: - Be uppercase (`text-transform`) - Letter spacing of 1px - Colour `#7f8c8d` - The `.bio` should: - Have line height 1.6 - Colour `#555` - The `.btn` (the link) should: - Have background colour `#3498db` - Text colour white - Padding: 10px 20px - No underline - Display as inline‑block (so padding works well) - Rounded corners Write the CSS rules in the exact order mentioned. Use comments to separate sections.
hints: Use `text-decoration: none;` to remove underline from the link.
expectedOutput: A CSS file with all styles applied. The card will look like a modern, clean profile snippet.
